source.source_name: NBB Central Balance Sheet Office (annual accounts, XBRL)
source.attribution: Source: National Bank of Belgium — Central Balance Sheet Office.

access.note: Free developer account at developer.cbso.nbb.be (CLIENT_ID + approval). Authentic Data is free; Improved Data is paid. CONSULT (consult.cbso.nbb.be) is free per-entity without an account.

transport.base_url: https://ws.cbso.nbb.be/ (web services; confirm from technical guide)

pagination.note: Authentic Data Query: list a company's deposit references by EnterpriseNumber, then fetch each filing (XBRL/JSON). Authentic Data Daily Extract: daily delta of new filings. Confirm exact endpoints from the CBSO web services technical guide.

snapshot.note: Persist the raw XBRL/JSON; parse against the versioned Belgian GAAP taxonomy.

parsing.notes: Belgian GAAP XBRL; concepts by rubriek code (total assets ~ rubriek 20/58). Handle micro/abbreviated/full schema variants + yearly taxonomy versions. omzet/operating result/net_income nullable for micro/abbreviated. JSON-from-XBRL available since 2022. EUR.

mapping_rules.financial_statements: One record per boekjaar x schema; map balans + resultatenrekening.
mapping_rules.matching: Clean join on EnterpriseNumber to the KBO spine.

fixture_requirements: full schema (volledig) with balance sheet + income statement (revenue present)
year with net loss (verlies); non-2022+ XBRL (no JSON)

live_test_plan.smoke: With NBB_CBSO creds, query deposit references for a known EnterpriseNumber; fetch one XBRL/JSON; parse totaal activa + omzet + winst/verlies.
live_test_plan.full: Behind NBB_CBSO_* env gate, use the Daily Extract for new filings + reference queries for back years; parse per taxonomy version; normalize to financial_statements[]; join on EnterpriseNumber.

blockers: Free developer account (CLIENT_ID + subscription key) required for web services.
Belgian GAAP XBRL: schema variants + yearly taxonomy versions to handle.
Micro/abbreviated companies disclose reduced figures (no revenue).
Improved Data (rectified) is paid; use free Authentic Data.
